description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'random_forest' baseline: TF-IDF word featurizer + Random Forest.
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'random_forest', group(s): tree); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
